SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7888
S.I, Special Branch ____ , 5-37
REPORT
Date May 3, 1937.

Subject Arrival of Sir Robert Ho Tung.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by [签名]

（左侧边栏批注：Received by S.B. D.C.）

Sir Robert Ho Tung arrived in Shanghai from Hongkong on May
2, 1937, in the s.s. "Empress of Asia."
Upon landing at the Customs Jetty at 5.50 p.m. he proceeded
to his residence, 457 Seymour Road.
The following members of the Special Branch performed
observation duties at the Customs Jetty and 457 Seymour Road
from 4.30 p.m. to 6.15 p.m.:-
D.S.I. Prokofiev
D. S. Pitts
D. I. Pan Lien-pih
C.D.C.49
C.D.C.199
C.D.C.357

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

（左下角印章：SPECIAL BRANCH / 3 MAY 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

D. C. (Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 7888
S.I，特务科 ____ ，5-37
报告
日期：1937年5月3日。

主题：何东爵士抵达。

撰写人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev） 转呈人：[签名]

（左侧边栏批注：特务科副科长收悉）

何东爵士（Sir Robert Ho Tung）于1937年5月2日乘“亚洲皇后”号轮船（s.s. "Empress of Asia"）从香港抵达上海。
下午5时50分在海关码头登岸后，他前往其位于西摩路457号的寓所。
下列特务科成员于下午4时30分至6时15分期间，在海关码头及西摩路457号执行监视任务：-
副督察 普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）
侦探警长 皮茨（Pitts）
侦探员 潘连璧（Pan Lien-pih）
华籍巡捕 49号
华籍巡捕 199号
华籍巡捕 357号

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
副督察

（左下角印章：特务科 / 1937年5月3日 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

副科长（特务科）

FORM NO. 3
G. 10M-11-35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7888
Special Branch
Date May 1 1937.

Subject (in full) Arrival of Sir Robert Ho Tung.

Made by / and Forwarded by C. D. I. Ross

Information has been received from the Canadian
Pacific Railway Co. to the effect that the s.s. "Empress of
Asia" will arrive in Shanghai at 4 p.m. May 2 and will berth
at the Shanghai & Hongkew Wharf Co.'s Pootung Wharf, and not
Hunt's Wharf as previously reported. The first tender will
leave the Customs Jetty at 3.30 p.m. and it is expected that
Sir Robert Ho Tung will arrive at the Customs Jetty at about
5 p.m. He will then proceed direct to his residence, No. 457
Seymour Road.

C. D. I.
Deputy Commissioner in Charge.

Distribution:
D.O. "A"
Central
Wayside mfd.
S.B. details will be on duty
at Customs jetty.

（左侧批注及印章）：
S.I.
Refer
